meta.title: Fresh Green Skin
meta.description: Fresh white-green theme with custom wallpapers (image/video), wallpaper-derived palettes, translucency, brand colours, quick chips, fonts and named themes
meta.detail: Settings → General → Wallpaper: bundled 4K photo, your own image or a looping video, transparency (optionally adaptive), palette from the wallpaper or your own per-area colours, translucent sidebar/bubbles, brand colours, quick-launch chips and a font picker; save combinations as named themes and switch with Ctrl+Alt+digit.
